steps.en: Install the SDK and set your keys
steps.zh: 安装 SDK 并设好 key

steps.en: Wrap the LLM client you already have
steps.zh: 包裹你已有的 LLM 客户端

steps.en: Attribute calls to an entity and a process
steps.zh: 把调用归属到 entity 和 process

steps.en: Call the model as usual — no memory API in the loop
steps.zh: 照常调用模型——循环里没有记忆 API

steps.en: Persists the conversation and injects relevant memories automatically
steps.zh: 自动持久化对话并注入相关记忆

steps.en: Background augmentation extracts facts, preferences, rules at entity/process/session levels
steps.zh: 后台 augmentation 抽取事实、偏好、规则

value.en: The next session already has the user's facts, people, preferences and rules in context — without writing a single search() call
value.zh: 下一次会话里，用户的事实、人物、偏好和规则已经在 context 里——而你没写过一句 search()
